commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: An illustrative wood/fire pairing is treated as vulnerable to a metal disruption.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如木必得水以生之，火以行之，土以培之，金以成之
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: Five-phase contribution example conditions wood formation on the others.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 五者聚而成形或過或缺則害
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: Commentary says both too much and too little can impair the historical configuration.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 一氣者為獨，曲直炎上之類是也
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: It defines a solitary/one-qi configuration through named traditional patterns.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 所生者為化神，化神昌旺，則其氣流行

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 三合者為全，主旺喜行財旺之地
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: It calls a three-harmony grouping complete and adds a source condition about wealth/luck stage.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 形全者宜損其有餘，形缺者宜補其不足
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: The commentary advises balancing excess in a full configuration and insufficiency in an incomplete one.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如寅卯辰，東方也，雜以亥卯未則太過

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如亥卯未木局，混一寅辰，則太強

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 行運南北，則有純疵，不能俱利
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: South/north luck-travel metaphor is conditionally not uniformly favorable.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如木局木方齊來，須要天干順序，行運不悖
commentary_quoted_source_candidates.working_gloss: Mixed directional and harmony wood formations also require compatible stem order and luck sequence.

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如寅卯辰全，而又乾透甲乙一元神，復又遇亥之生，未之庫，決不發福

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如甲乙日遇亥卯未全，而又乾透庚辛一官星，又見右寅，左辰，則名利無成

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 既從矣，當論所從之神

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如甲日主，生於四季，單遇一位己土，在月時上作合，（在年幹不是）不遇壬癸甲乙庚（印，劫，官），乃為化得真

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: （化神要通月令）

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 如土太旺，又要水為財，木為官，金為食傷

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 日主弱矣，財官強矣，不能不從，中有所助者，便假

commentary_quoted_source_candidates.original_chinese_anchor: 至於行運，財官得地，雖是假從，亦可富貴
